content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: A new recycling bill, designed to increase recycling rates and reduce waste in landfills, has been signed into law, earning praise from environmental advocates but sparking controversy among industry leaders.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The legislation requires businesses to implement more stringent recycling programs and provides incentives for consumers to recycle more.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Industry spokesperson Jane Smith said, 'While well-intentioned, this law could stifle innovation and hurt small businesses.'

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Environmentalists, on the other hand, see it as a crucial step towards sustainability.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: The new law will take effect in six months, giving businesses time to adjust their operations.
